part.name: OD-E02_control-button-board
part.what_it_is: Front control button board of a DeLonghi espresso machine: stepped moulded housing with a snap-fitted back cover, PCB connector shroud, two screw holes, bent mounting tab, four latch hoops and three push-button caps (1 cup, 2 cups, steam), delivered as one fused solid of the assembly as scanned.

method_summary: Intake: sha256 of the scan, working copy, noise floor on the mounting-tab top face, datum = back cover floor (XY), origin on the middle button collar axis, +X from the housing end face.

Measure: every dimension from the full-resolution scan in the frozen datum frame (scan-only, no calipers); the housing tiers are offsets of one core outline whose corner centres were fitted once; edge rounds measured from the scan distance at the sharp corners.

Rebuild: build123d, plan-first; tier prisms from the offset core, a fitted chamfer plane, sub-bodies for band, collars, caps, shroud, tab and hoops, cut tools for pocket, recesses, holes; every fillet logged; one valid closed solid exported in the datum and the scan frame.
Verify: an independent agent re-ran its own ICP and the two-way full-resolution deviation under the declared regime.
Deliver: README and manifest rendered from the JSON records, fresh-process reproducibility check, one zip with deliverables and all source files.

limitations.text: Scan-only: no calipers, so Tier-1 did not run (absent, not passed) and absolute scale is not caliper-verified (CHK-SCALE flag at intake). no Tier-1 (no calipers run).
limitations.rerun_trigger: any caliper reading (envelope X/Y, a cap diameter, the tab hole)

limitations.text: Unscanned regions are modelled from assumptions: connector shroud interior depth, shroud-to-rim slot floor, screw through-bores, cap-collar recess ceilings. They hold almost all of the observable CAD-to-scan band miss, which the owner accepted (decisions/accept_band.md).
limitations.rerun_trigger: a re-scan covering the shroud interior, the slot and the bores, or depth / pin-gauge readings of them

limitations.text: The functional zones Z1-Z6 are reported per zone only: the baseline-skill regime has no interface band.
limitations.rerun_trigger: a project spec that bands the interfaces

limitations.text: Two fillets were built smaller than measured because the wall is thinner than the two measured top rounds together: rim top outer edge and shroud top inner edge (REDUCED in build/export_check.json).
limitations.rerun_trigger: a caliper reading of the rim and shroud wall thickness

limitations.text: The loose button caps are fused to the housing at their scanned pose (the middle cap sits slightly tilted in its bore); the solid is the assembly as scanned.
limitations.rerun_trigger: owner request for a per-part STEP or the nominal cap pose

limitations.text: Overlays and zoom sections are drawn in the builder datum frame, before the verifier's ICP correction of {{gate:deviation.registration.delta_mm}} mm.
limitations.rerun_trigger: an ICP correction above the overlay tolerance on a re-run

assumptions.text: Connector shroud interior (header, pins, floor) is not scanned; the interior pocket is cut down to the deepest scanned wall point.
Screw through-bore between the back counterbore and the front bore is not scanned; it is assumed continuous at the measured bore radius, and the front bore stops where the scan stops seeing it.
The narrow slot between the connector shroud and the rim is closed at the floor plane (no scan below it).
The loose button caps are fused to the housing at their scanned pose; the clearance between each cap and its bore is modelled only as far up as the scan saw it.

not_fit_for: manufacture or tooling of any part of the assembly until the functional interfaces (caps, collars, screw holes, tab hole, connector shroud) are calipered
separate-part use: housing, cover and caps are fused into one solid; a multi-body STEP is a separate job
the connector interior (header and pins were not scanned)
fit_for: envelope, packaging and fit studies of the scanned assembly in the machine front panel
a design-intent starting model for the housing (parametric build123d source and parameter table included)

feature_tree.feature: rim + pocket (offset core outline), inner latch bosses
stepped tiers T0/T2/T3 with junction fillets and the -Y chamfer plane
button band, collars, outer collar cuts, cap clearance recesses
button caps (B2 round and tilted as scanned, B1/B3 oval with inclined tops)
connector shroud, shroud interior, screw holes
mounting tab (plate, leg, drafted side flanges, hole)
